1. Mr. Rajesh Pandey and Mr. K.K. Joshi, learned
counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Deputy Advocate General
for State of Uttarakhand/ respondent nos. 1, 2 & 6.
3. Ms. Anjali Bhargava, learned counsel for
respondent no. 4.
4. I n this Writ Petition, filed in Public I nterest,
petitioner alleges that respondent no. 7 is running two
Colleges from same building. Names of these two
colleges are Dr. Susheela Tiwari P.G. College, Sitarganj
and Dr. Susheela Tiwari B.Ed. College, Sitarganj. I t is
further contended that bye-laws of Kumaun University
have been violated, while granting affiliation to these
two Colleges.
5. Counsel for petitioner further subm its that the
norms laid down by National Council for Teachers
Education are also not being followed by these two
Colleges, however, the concerned authorities have not
taken any action in the matter. Attention of this Court
has been drawn to Annexure No. 16 to Writ Petition,
which is the show-cause notice issued by Kumaun
University to Management of both the aforesaid
Colleges.
6. The relief sought in Writ Petition is as follows :
"1- A writ, order or direction in the nature of m andam us
com m anding the official Respondents to constitute a high
level inquiry com m ittee of experts in order to have a
thorough inquiry in to the com plaints m ade by the
Petitioner in respect to financial, adm inistrative and other

irregularities com m itted by the private Respondent college
and accordingly persons involved in corruption m ay be
punished."
7. Learned State Counsel points out that petitioner
was serving as Librarian in Dr. Susheela Tiwari B.Ed.
College, Sitarganj between 2014 to 2022, and this
appears to be a case of personal vendetta by petitioner
against Management of those Colleges.
8. Having regard to the pleadings made in Writ
Petition, we are not inclined to entertain this PI L.
However, having regard to the issue raised in Writ
Petition, we dispose of the same with liberty to
petitioner to approach the authorities of Kumaun
University, and Kumaun University shall look into the
issues raised by petitioner, by passing a reasoned
order within six m onths from date of presentation of
representation by petitioner.
9. The Writ Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
 ( Viv ek Bh ar t i Sh ar m a, J.) ( Man o j Ku m ar Tiw ar i, A.C.J.)
